svg.title: One host and N owners: the time of one round
svg.desc: Four panels: a Rust host and a Python host, with owners that answer at once or wait 1 ms. Each shows the median time of one round, one request to each of 1 to 256 owners, for call_all, eight threads that each use call_all, one thread for each session, one call after another, and plain pipes without a protocol. Bars span the three block medians.
